title: Physics-guided machine learning for saturation control across variable hydraulic conditions in heap leaching
abstract: arXiv:2610.15947v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Heap-leaching hydraulics vary between regions of an ore bed, motivating fast prediction models that accommodate different material properties. This study develops a parameter-conditioned physics-guided machine-learning (PGML) surrogate and demonstrates its use in simulated saturation control. A dataset of 4096 numerical Richards-equation trajectories was divided into 2867 training, 614 validation and 615 evaluation cases. The network predicts hourly saturation profiles from the current profile, irrigation rate and four hydraulic parameters, and is trained with an approximate Gardner mass-balance penalty. A daily predictive controller compared 200 constant irrigation rates over a 24-hour horizon. Across the evaluation cases, the median full-cycle tracking deviation was 4.9% of a 0.70 saturation target, equal to that of a tuned proportional-integral (PI) controller, while the PGML controller reached the target without overshoot in the me

translated_title: 物理引导的机器学习用于堆浸中可变水力条件下的饱和度控制
translated_abstract: 堆浸水力学在矿床不同区域之间存在差异，因此需要能够适应不同物料特性的快速预测模型。本研究开发了一种参数条件化的物理引导机器学习（PGML）代理模型，并在模拟饱和度控制中展示了其应用。一个包含4096条数值Richards方程轨迹的数据集被划分为2867个训练样本、614个验证样本和615个评估样本。该网络根据当前饱和度剖面、灌溉速率和四个水力参数预测逐小时的饱和度剖面，并采用近似Gardner质量守恒惩罚项进行训练。每日预测控制器在24小时时间范围内比较了200个恒定灌溉速率。在全部评估案例中，全周期跟踪偏差的中位数为0.70饱和度目标的4.9%，与调谐后的比例-积分（PI）控制器相当，而PGML控制器在（摘要在此处截断）中无超调地达到了目标。
tldr: 该研究开发了一种参数条件化的物理引导机器学习代理模型，可基于不同水力参数快速预测堆浸饱和度演化，实现了与调谐PI控制器精度相当且无超调的饱和度预测控制。
en_tdlr: This study develops a parameter-conditioned physics-guided machine learning surrogate for fast saturation prediction under varying hydraulic parameters, enabling predictive saturation control in heap leaching that matches a tuned PI controller in accuracy while achieving the target without overshoot.
